name: Loves Green Playground
text: Highwood Parish Council's playground behind the village hall at Loves Green, with climbing frames, swings and slides for toddlers to teenagers, plus adult gym equipment and a football goal.

name: Edney Common Playground
text: Highwood Parish Council's playground at Edney Common, with a large climbing frame and slides, swings, a see-saw, a small playhouse and a football goal.
